title.zh: 北冥的鱼的 DSH 插件

description.en: Community DSH bundles published from github.com/nahida38454.
description.zh: 由 github.com/nahida38454 发布的 DSH 插件合集。

description.en: Totals the token usage recorded in every DSH session log: an all-time total, live sessions, a per-session ranking in a sidebar panel, plus a per-session counter in the conversation header. Claude Code usage is folded in when its index is present.
description.zh: 汇总所有 DSH 会话日志里记录的真实 Token 消耗：侧边栏面板显示全站累计、活跃会话与按会话排行，对话头部另外显示当前会话的实时用量。检测到 Claude Code 索引时一并计入。
